bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
pg="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])postgres([-_]|$)' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 71
user="$(docker exec "$pg" printenv POSTGRES_USER)"
test -n "$user" || exit 72
blocking="$(docker exec "$pg" psql -U "$user" -d videobot -Atqc "SELECT count(*) FROM videobot_webhook_updates u CROSS JOIN videobot_poll_cursor c WHERE c.consumer_id='createvdobot' AND u.status='needs_reconcile' AND u.update_id>c.last_update_id" 2>/dev/null)" || exit 73
test "$blocking" = 0 || exit 81
older="$(docker exec "$pg" psql -U "$user" -d videobot -Atqc "SELECT count(*) FROM videobot_webhook_updates u CROSS JOIN videobot_poll_cursor c WHERE c.consumer_id='createvdobot' AND u.status='needs_reconcile' AND u.update_id<=c.last_update_id" 2>/dev/null)" || exit 74
test "$older" = 0 || exit 82
exit 0
